title: AI Photo Booth
summary: Free AI photo booth: turn your selfie into a black and white four frame strip, a retro film strip, a holiday frame, a glam studio shot or a cartoon booth.
body_markdown:
### Is there a free AI photo booth?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6, which made every photo booth picture on this page from a selfie, costs 5 credits an image at its default settings.


### How do I make a photo booth strip from my own photo?


Add a clear photo of yourself as a reference image, then ask for a photo booth strip of four frames, describe a different pose for each frame and name the look, such as classic black and white or faded 1970s colour.


### Can I make AI photo booth pictures of guests at a party or wedding?


Yes. Collect the photos guests share with you, add each one as a reference image and use one themed prompt, such as a holiday frame or a wedding flower wall, so every guest gets a matching set of booth pictures to keep or post.


### Can I put two or more people in one photo booth strip?


Yes. Add a photo with everyone in it or one photo of each person, describe each by their hair and one feature, and say where each one sits; GPT Image 2.6 takes up to 10 reference images.


### What photo booth styles can AI make?


Most booth looks work when you name them: classic black and white four frame strips, faded 1970s colour strips, early 2000s sticker sheets, holiday and party frames, wedding guest prints, glam studio portraits and cartoon strips.


### Can I turn a photo booth picture into a video?


Yes. Use one booth frame as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe the poses changing between flashes, and ask it to keep the faces, the film look and the grain exactly as they are.
